running-batch-changes-server-side-not-en: Running batch changes server-side is not enabled
install-executors-batch-changes-server-s: Install executors to enable running batch changes server-side instead of locally. Executors can also be autoscaled to speed up creating large-scale batch changes.
sourcegraph-cli-instructions: Use the <0>Sourcegraph CLI (src)</0> to run this batch change locally.
batch-change-preview-instructions: Follow the URL printed in your terminal to see the preview and (when you're ready) create the batch change.
src-cli-description: src cli is a command line interface to Sourcegraph. Its <0>batch</0> command allows to run batch specification files using Docker.
